say:6:1029413005:0.text: Yes, a strong foundation is important... and to get that, I must work hard to get into the Serene Lyceum!

say:7:1029413007:0.text: But I've already failed the entrance exam for the Serene Lyceum three times...
say:7:1029413007:0.source_cn: 可是我之前参加莱希拉姆的入学考试，失败了三次……

say:8:1029413008:0.text: All those spells and incantations are too complicated! I just can't remember them all.
say:8:1029413008:0.source_cn: 那些术式和咒语什么的，真的很复杂啊！我根本就记不住。

say:12:1029413011:1.text: No. That's why I chose to leave home and train while working at the Evergreen Conservatory!
say:12:1029413011:1.source_cn: 嗯。所以我才决定离开家，在冬青学会里一边工作，一遍修炼！

say:13:1029413012:1.source_cn: 说到这个……老师，我可以求你帮个忙吗？

say:17:1029413016:2.text: Because I can't take it anymore! What do you guys even want?! What's with this little performance? Are you just mocking me?
say:17:1029413016:2.source_cn: 因为我实在忍不下去了！你们几个，到底想干什么？该不会就...

say:21:1029413019:1.source_cn: 你怎么还看不起人呢！我、我知道的事情可多了！

say:22:1029413020:1.text: Seems like such a clumsy move actually works on some people...
say:22:1029413020:1.source_cn: 原来这种拙劣的激将法还真能骗到人……
